title: Men's Casual Shoes – Low & Lightweight with Non-Slip Sole
descriptionHtml:
One shoe for the walk. One for work. One for the woods. Or?

The shoe rack is overflowing, yet it's always the wrong pair. Too heavy, too warm, too slippery.

The solution: one shoe that handles it all

Extremely lightweight casual shoes with a non-slip sole that grips on wet surfaces. Stylish enough for town, tough enough for the forest trail – all year round.

Features

  • Won't tire out your feet – extremely lightweight
  • Grips on wet surfaces – non-slip sole
  • Cool all day – breathable material
  • Gray with red details
  • Available in large sizes

Change of Mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
